subject: Commercial gates snapshot + procurement timeline (EdgeHealth)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@edgehealth.com>, EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial gates snapshot + procurement timeline (EdgeHealth)

Hi Olivia / Procurement team —

Thanks again for a constructive call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed short timeline so we have alignment on who's doing what and when. Per our conversation, EdgeHealth is planning to start a pilot that will process sensitive patient-summaries (PII present), so the main procurement gates are: legal SOW acceptance, security questionnaire + evidence review, finance/PO issuance.

Summary (high level):
- Legal: review of SOW draft + standard Redwood terms (expect 1–2 weeks if changes are minor).
- Security: your security team will want the completed questionnaire and SOC2 evidence (we can provide both; see attached "Security_QA_Responses.docx"). Expect 1–3 weeks depending on follow-ups.
- Finance: internal approvals and PO issuance — typical 1–2 weeks after pricing sign-off.

Commercial path options you flagged:
- PO (preferred for enterprise): standard monthly invoices + PO.
- Corporate card: acceptable for pilot under $25k ARR; faster but limited for long-term commitments.
- Marketplace (AWS/Azure): possible if you want single-vendor procurement and marketplace billing; adds ~1 week for procurement registration.

Proposed mutual action plan (attached as "Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx"):
- Today (Oct 22): I share SOW draft + MAP + security bundle.
- Oct 26: EdgeHealth legal to provide comments on SOW (Tom?).
- Oct 29: EdgeHealth security to confirm initial questionnaire review and list any open evidence requests.
- Nov 5: Finance target to confirm PO timeline or card approval method.

Please confirm who internally will own Legal / Security / Finance on your side (names + emails) so we can keep the MAP updated. Also—any preference on billing instrument (PO vs card vs marketplace) for the pilot?

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (map), EdgeHealth_SOW_draft.pdf (SOW), Security_QA_Responses.docx

Short ask: reply with owners for Legal / Security / Finance and a preferred billing path. I’ll loop in Ben for contracting and Monica for onboarding readiness once we have the owners.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@edgehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: EdgeHealth Procurement <procurement@edgehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@edgehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial gates snapshot + procurement timeline (EdgeHealth)

Thanks Marcus — useful summary. Quick answers inline: 

- Legal owner: Tom Reynolds (tom in CC) will take the SOW review. He expects to return redlines by end of day Oct 29; if it's just standard terms we should be done quickly.
- Security owner: I’m looping in our security lead (procurement@edgehealth.com will route to Lisa Chen). She’ll start with the "Security_QA_Responses.docx" and will likely ask for the SOC2 report and network diagrams. Can you confirm where to find the SOC2 and the expected retention of logs?
- Finance: I own commercial approvals for pilots under $50k; we prefer PO for anything above $10k. For the pilot, we may attempt card to speed things up but will likely move to PO if the pilot scales.

On billing instrument: Preferred is PO, but we can use a card for the initial test to accelerate kickoff. We’ll confirm by Nov 5.

One request: can Ben share a clean redline-friendly SOW (track changes off) and a short summary of any non-standard clause risks (data residency, audit access)? That will speed things for our legal team.

Olivia
Olivia Barnes
Director of Product, EdgeHealth
obarnes@edgehealth.com | (415) 555-3434

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@edgehealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@edgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial gates snapshot + procurement timeline (EdgeHealth)

Hi Olivia / Tom —

I’ve attached a clean SOW (EdgeHealth_SOW_draft.pdf) with a short cover note summarizing the few areas that deviate from our standard template:
- Data residency: we proposed US-only hosting by default; if you need multi-region we’ll need to update the appendix.
- Audit access & eDiscovery: standard audit window in the SOW is 90 days; we can extend on request but may need a separate addendum.
- Additional indemnity: we keep standard vendor indemnities; no unusual clauses here.

SOC2 & evidence: SOC2 Type II report is available via customer portal. I’ve pasted the shared link to the SOC2 in the MAP folder (see HubSpot link). For network diagrams and architecture, Monica can provide an onboarding-ready package — Monica, I can you drop the runbook and diagrams into the shared Drive folder?

Timeline note: if Tom returns simple redlines by Oct 29, we can turn around a second pass within 2 business days and get legal sign-off by Nov 3. Security review timelines vary; please flag any hard stops.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: EdgeHealth_SOW_draft.pdf

From: Olivia Barnes <obarnes@edgehealth.com>

Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial gates snapshot + procurement timeline (EdgeHealth)

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Ben. Tom will share redlines by EOD today. Lisa from security will reach out if they need the SOC2 link or onboarding diagrams — Olivia (me) will confirm by Nov 5 whether we use card or PO for the pilot.

Next actions (confirmed):
- Tom (EdgeHealth Legal): deliver redlines by 2026-10-29 EOD.
- EdgeHealth Security (Lisa via procurement@): review security QA doc and request SOC2/diagrams by 2026-10-29.
- Marcus / Ben / Monica (Redwood): stand by to address redlines and upload onboarding artifacts to the MAP folder; Marcus to update MAP after each milestone.
- Olivia (EdgeHealth): confirm billing instrument by 2026-11-05.

I’ll update our internal procurement tracker and share the PO workflow if we go that route. Thanks — excited to get the pilot started.

Olivia
